orientationNote: Sheet default faces +row (down-left) with its back to the RIGHT wall (row 0). The mirrored image (_m) faces +col (down-right), back to the LEFT wall (col 0). Rotate = swap default/mirrored and swap footprint [w,d]. Round decor is angle-neutral; flip it freely.
rotation: 2-direction: rotate = swap image default <-> mirrored (_m, horizontal flip) and swap footprint [w,d]. True 4-direction rotation would need back-view art, which is NOT included.
shadowRule: Shadows are not baked. The app draws shadows/shadow-{w}x{d}.png centred on the footprint centre under each floor item (decor: same sprite at 80% scale; rug/decals: none). Toggle freely.
formats: every image ships as .png and .webp (same name).

tileRules.floor: per tile (col,row): draw isoTiles[(col%2)(row%2)] with its top-left at world px (1920+(col-row)*78-80, 900+(col+row)*39-2). Image 160×82 = 156×78 diamond + 2 px bleed each side. Every texture repeats every 2 tiles, so the parity variant keeps planks/herringbone/checker continuous across neighbours; all 4 variants are always shipped.
tileRules.wall: left wall column i (i=0 at back corner, along col 0 / rows): draw columnsL[i] at (1920-(i+1)*78-2, 450+i*39-2). Right wall column i (along row 0 / cols): columnsR[i] at (1920+i*78-2, 450+i*39-2). Strip 82×493 = 78-px column × 450-px wall (+39 px slope) + 2 px bleed. Right-wall strips are pre-shaded ×0.88 like the default room.
tileRules.drawOrder: draw floor tiles row-major in any order (no overlap except 2 px bleed, same texture under bleed); then room-frame-{view|edit}; then items as before.
